snippet.title: Crown & Applause | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Perform as a royal mouse-jester in a kingdom ruled by silence. 

Crown & Applause is a narrative rhythm indie game with a medieval bardcore soundtrack. Read the crowd, work the court, and decide who your act really serves. One bad show and they reach for the tomatoes.
